title: Install Pneumatic Cylinder After Replacement (transfer fittings, bracket/rod end, reconnect air, reassemble, restart operator station)
summary: Reinstall a replaced pneumatic cylinder correctly so the lift plate rod end is pinned/retained, air lines are reconnected, covers/panels are reinstalled, and the operator station is restarted to resume normal operation.
when_to_use: Use this procedure after replacing a pneumatic cylinder when the cylinder must be reinstalled with the correct mechanical retention (rod end pin + retaining ring), air line reconnection, and reassembly, followed by restarting the operator station.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: performs the physical installation steps and restarts the operator station.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the pneumatic cylinder assembly
Hand tools for M6 socket head screws and M8 button-head screws
Tools to install pin and retaining ring
Ability to restart the operator station

access_required: Physical access to the pneumatic cylinder assembly
external_references: OptiSweep Operation and Maintenance Manual, section 7.3.10.2 Pneumatic Cylinder Installation (pages 151–153) and the referenced 'Starting The Operator Station' section on page 66

visual_references.description: Pneumatic cylinder assembly figure referenced by the pneumatic cylinder replacement/install section.

steps.title: Transfer air fittings and spherical rod end to the new cylinder
steps.purpose: Ensure the new cylinder has the correct air fittings and spherical rod end configuration before installation.
steps.instruction: Transfer the air fittings and the spherical rod end from the old cylinder to the new cylinder.
steps.expected_result: The new pneumatic cylinder has the air line fittings and spherical rod end installed/attached as transferred from the old cylinder.
steps.healthy_condition: Air line fittings and spherical rod end on the new cylinder match the transferred configuration from the old cylinder (no missing components).
steps.failure_condition: Air line fittings or the spherical rod end are not fully transferred/installed on the new cylinder.

actions.label: Transfer fittings and rod end
actions.exact_action: Transfer the air fittings and spherical rod end from the old cylinder to the new cylinder.

source_evidence.quote: 1. Transfer the air fittings and spherical rod end from the old cylinder to the new cylinder. AIR LINE FITTINGS SPHERICA L ROD END

steps.title: Mount cylinder bottom in bracket and install bracket half with two M6 screws
steps.purpose: Secure the cylinder mechanically in the bracket using the specified fasteners.
steps.instruction: Place the bottom of the cylinder in the bracket, then install the other half of the bracket using two (2) M6 socket head screws.
steps.expected_result: The cylinder bottom is seated in the bracket and the other half of the bracket is installed using two (2) M6 socket head screws.
steps.healthy_condition: Bracket halves are installed with exactly two (2) M6 socket head screws securing the cylinder in place.
steps.failure_condition: Cylinder bottom is not seated in the bracket or the bracket half is not secured with the two (2) M6 socket head screws.

actions.label: Seat cylinder and install bracket with M6 screws
actions.exact_action: Place the bottom of the cylinder in the bracket and install the other half of the bracket with the two (2) M6 socket head screws.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the rod end cannot be fully seated between the lift plate brackets or if the pin/retaining ring cannot be installed securely.

source_evidence.quote: 2. Place the bottom of the cylinder in the bracket and install the other half of the bracket with the two (2) M6 socket head screws. M6 SCREWS

steps.title: Install rod end between lift plate brackets and secure with pin and retaining ring
steps.purpose: Provide correct mechanical retention of the lift plate rod end.
steps.instruction: Slip the rod end between the brackets on the lift plate, then insert the pin and retaining ring.
steps.expected_result: The rod end is positioned between the lift plate brackets and the pin and retaining ring are installed.
steps.healthy_condition: Pin and retaining ring are installed to retain the rod end between the lift plate brackets.
steps.failure_condition: Rod end cannot be fully seated between the lift plate brackets or the pin/retaining ring cannot be installed securely.

actions.label: Seat rod end and install pin/retaining ring
actions.exact_action: Slip the rod end between the brackets on the lift plate and insert the pin and retaining ring.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the rod end cannot be fully seated between the lift plate brackets or if the pin/retaining ring cannot be installed securely.

source_evidence.quote: 3. Slip the rod end between the brackets on the lift plate and insert the pin and retaining ring. RE TAINING RING PIN

steps.title: Reconnect air lines
steps.purpose: Restore pneumatic connections required for cylinder operation.
steps.expected_result: Air lines are reconnected to the pneumatic cylinder as required by the installation.
steps.healthy_condition: Air line reconnections are complete (no disconnected fittings at the cylinder connection points).
steps.failure_condition: Air line reconnection is incomplete or fittings cannot be reattached as required.
stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if air line reconnection is incomplete or fittings cannot be reattached as required.

source_evidence.quote: 4. Reconnect the air lines. AIR LINES

steps.title: Replace cover plate using eight M8 button-head screws
steps.purpose: Reinstall the cover plate to restore the station’s protective enclosure.
steps.instruction: Replace the cover plate using the eight (8) M8 button-head screws.
steps.expected_result: Cover plate is installed and fastened with eight (8) M8 button-head screws.
steps.healthy_condition: All eight (8) M8 button-head screws are installed securing the cover plate.
steps.failure_condition: Cover plate is not fully fastened or fewer than eight (8) M8 button-head screws are installed.

actions.label: Install cover plate with M8 screws
actions.exact_action: Replace the cover plate using the eight (8) M8 button-head screws.

source_evidence.quote: 5. Replace the cover plate using the eight (8) M8 button-head screws. M8 BUTTON-HEAD SCREWS

steps.title: Reinstall top and/or bottom side panels if necessary
steps.purpose: Restore side panel enclosure components that may have been removed for access.
steps.instruction: Reinstall the top and/or bottom side panels, if necessary.
steps.expected_result: Top and/or bottom side panels are reinstalled if they were removed.
steps.healthy_condition: Side panels are in place (top and/or bottom as applicable) with no missing panels.
steps.failure_condition: Side panels that were removed are not reinstalled.

actions.label: Reinstall side panels
actions.exact_action: Reinstall the top and/or bottom side panels, if necessary.

source_evidence.quote: 6. Reinstall the top and/or bottom side panels, if necessary.

steps.title: Restart the operator station
steps.purpose: Resume normal operation after mechanical and pneumatic reassembly.
steps.instruction: Re-start the operator station (see “Starting The Operator Station” on page 66).
steps.expected_result: The operator station is restarted after reassembly.
steps.healthy_condition: Operator station returns to normal operation after restart.
steps.failure_condition: Operator station restart does not bring the station back to normal operation after restart.

actions.label: Restart operator station
actions.exact_action: Re-start the operator station (see "Starting The Operator Station" on page 66).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the operator station restart does not bring the station back to normal operation after restart, escalate for further troubleshooting.

source_evidence.quote: 7. Re-start the operator station (see "Starting The Operator Station" on page 66).

success_criteria: Pneumatic cylinder is mechanically secured with the bracket installed using two (2) M6 socket head screws.
Lift plate rod end is retained with the pin and retaining ring installed.
Cover plate is fastened using eight (8) M8 button-head screws.
Top and/or bottom side panels are reinstalled if they were removed.
Operator station restart returns the station to normal operation.
healthy_conditions: Rod end is fully seated between lift plate brackets and retained with pin and retaining ring.
Air line reconnections are complete at the cylinder connection points.
Cover plate is secured with eight (8) M8 button-head screws.
Operator station returns to normal operation after restart.
failure_conditions: Rod end cannot be fully seated between lift plate brackets or pin/retaining ring cannot be installed securely.
Air line reconnection is incomplete or fittings cannot be reattached as required.
Operator station restart does not bring the station back to normal operation.
escalation_guidance: Stop and escalate if rod end retention (pin/retaining ring) cannot be completed securely.
Stop and escalate if air line reconnection cannot be completed as required.
If restarting the operator station does not return the station to normal operation, escalate for further troubleshooting.
